name: v4.3.0
body:
## What's Changed
* docs: fix the run_install example in the Readme by @dreyks in https://github.com/pnpm/action-setup/pull/175
* chore: remove unused `@types/node-fetch` dependency by @silverwind in https://github.com/pnpm/action-setup/pull/186
* Clarify that package_json_file is relative to GITHUB_WORKSPACE by @chris-martin in https://github.com/pnpm/action-setup/pull/184
* feat: store caching by @jrmajor in https://github.com/pnpm/action-setup/pull/188
* refactor: remove star imports by @KSXGitHub in https://github.com/pnpm/action-setup/pull/196
* fix(ci): exclude macos by @KSXGitHub in https://github.com/pnpm/action-setup/pull/197

## New Contributors
* @dreyks made their first contribution in https://github.com/pnpm/action-setup/pull/175
* @silverwind made their first contribution in https://github.com/pnpm/action-setup/pull/186
* @chris-martin made their first contribution in https://github.com/pnpm/action-setup/pull/184
* @jrmajor made their first contribution in https://github.com/pnpm/action-setup/pull/188
* @Boosted-Bonobo made their first contribution in https://github.com/pnpm/action-setup/pull/199

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/pnpm/action-setup/compare/v4.2.0...v4.3.0
